scope: Original six sealed business regressions on the unchanged candidate; no repeat G01, no installation, no formal main evaluation
caseExecutionMeaning: Each case reserves one application-attempt slot for local refusal. These six slots cannot become model dispatches. Cases execute in sealed order; the first terminal case failure ends the round.
budgetMeaning: Input+output stopping threshold, not a server-enforced cap. Cached tokens are already included in input and are not added again. An in-flight request may exceed the threshold. The original 45-minute window includes all model calls, human actions, independent review, revision and restarts; it never resets and is not a completion guarantee.

conditionalBudgetAudit.method: For every preceding request assume usage=serializedInputBytes+1024. Fill each unused dispatch slot with its case maximum observed input and reservation. Peak=known assumed prefix+next reservation. This is a conditional audit, not a token forecast or completion guarantee.

scope: Current closed G01 and exact candidate identity
New approval only; old authorization and missing authorization rejected before dispatch
40 attempts and at most 34 dispatches; no G01 quota
Original human confirmation, explicit recheck, content review and acceptance remain separate
Terminal outcome metrics and exact content binding
Title coverage requires successful final raw response, exact saved claim and evidence, valid offset, real dispatch, no cache reuse

reusedRegression.meaning: Historical six-case complete lifecycle and five fault scenarios on this exact candidate, reused only after executor equivalence and shared-module checks. All six raw output directories re-parsed by the new reporter; no lifecycle or real model was run this turn.

coverage.sixCaseWorkflow: Two invalid fixed drafts blocked unchanged and non-acceptable; four qualified generated tasks independently reviewed then accepted by the human. F05 counts as one final task after its planned revision.
coverage.F03: Business success and explicit title-citation coverage are separate. Body-only citations may pass the business case. Title coverage requires naturally emitted explicit field:title, successful final validation of the same draft, exact source/quote/claim binding and real dispatch, without cache reuse.
coverage.humanRecheck: Only actual human expression confirmation followed by the separate explicit recheck action counts. At most one confirmation and recheck per planned draft stage.
coverage.revision: F05 revised draft and basis must change; old records must remain intact. Revision-stage human recheck coverage requires a natural trigger.
coverage.restart: F06 cold restarts before advance and at review must preserve state and dispatch no models.
coverage.untriggered: Report not-covered. Do not force output, alter claim kinds, fabricate human actions or add calls to obtain coverage.

metrics.processCompletion: Qualified human-accepted generated tasks / 4 planned, plus / generated tasks actually attempted. Report six-case workflow outcome separately.
metrics.hallucination: Independent review of initial generated drafts, final generated drafts and verification-released drafts separately. Fixed invalid drafts are not generated hallucinations.
metrics.falseBlock: Qualified drafts hard-rejected / qualified drafts with a completed semantic verdict. Technical failures and human pending are listed separately.
metrics.falseRelease: Unqualified generated drafts passed / unqualified generated drafts with a completed semantic verdict; fixed invalid releases reported separately.
metrics.cost: Actual input, output, total, cached-in-input, per case and per qualified human-accepted task. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.
metrics.coverageLimit: Six exposed regressions cannot establish broad production rates or replace fresh blind acceptance.

completionCriteria.sixCasePass: Two fixed invalid drafts blocked unchanged; four generated tasks independently qualified and accepted by the human; all required stages and known usage within the original limits
completionCriteria.targetCoverage: Title citations, human rechecks, revision and restart reported separately; no natural trigger is not-covered
completionCriteria.release: This evaluation does not authorize installation or publication
completionCriteria.failure: First terminal case failure ends the round; no automatic extra round

nextDecision: After a separately approved run, independently audit outcomes and close the authorization once. If passed, decide delivery readiness using actual coverage; if failed, report exact evidence and stop. No automatic extra round or installation.
